512-3990-5475.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce {W}.
Incubation Druid and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-3990-5475.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Incubation Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-3990-5475.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Incubation Druid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3384-4550-5567-6495--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3384-4550-5567-6495--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3384-4550-5567-6495--112.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2281-5987-8095.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Angel of Indemnity
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Saffi triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

4871-5231-6476-7874.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4871-5231-6476-7874.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning The Immortal Weapons and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When The Immortal Weapons enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including The Immortal Weapons, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2685-4186-6824-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-4186-6824-7810.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1978-3717-5143.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Repeat

664-4083-6899.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Frilled Deathspitter.
Frilled Deathspitter is indestructible.
664-4083-6899.description:
Deal damage to Frilled Deathspitter.
Frilled Deathspitter and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Frilled Deathspitter trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Frilled Deathspitter instead of you due to With Great Power....
Repeat from step 2.

3560-5686-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2457-4321-5794-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2267-2558-2829--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2267-2558-2829--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Tormod triggers. Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1860-3765-6102.manaNeeded: {7}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
1860-3765-6102.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
1860-3765-6102.description:
Activate Emergence Zone by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 2, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

1698-3260-3540-5930.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
1698-3260-3540-5930.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-3260-3540-5930.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

643-3276-3496-4071.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Be'lakor's second ability triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Dread Slaver dies as a state-based action due to its deathtouch.
Dread Slaver triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

222-4050-4128-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
You control a Saproling.
222-4050-4128-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Bloom Tender and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana of any color(s).
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and Bloom Tender to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Bloom Tender enter the battlefield, Chainer triggers twice and Slimefoot and Squee triggers once.
Resolve both Chainer triggers, giving Slimefoot and Squee and Bloom Tender haste.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2233-3962-4050.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
2233-3962-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Blightbelly Rat, adding one mana of any color.
When Blightbelly Rat dies, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, returning Blightbelly Rat from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1274-2086-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Repeat.

220-896-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Activate General's Regalia by paying {3}, choosing to redirect the next damage Volcano Hellion does to you to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve Volcano Hellion's ability, dealing an arbirarily large amount of damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to target opponent.

927-2278.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, causing an opponent who controls no Swamps to gain control of Bog Serpent.
Bog Serpent triggers, causing the opponent to sacrifice it.
However, Bog Serpent cannot be sacrificed due to its ability granted by Jon Irenicus.
Bog Serpent triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

1636-2273-3825-4587.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional Sliver.
An additional Sliver with mana value 1 in library.
1636-2273-3825-4587.description:
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Sliver Overlord's first ability by paying {3}, searching your library for a Sliver with mana value 1.
Cast that Sliver by paying {1}.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat, gaining {1} more each time in step 1 and searching for a Sliver costing up to {1} more each time in step 2.

411-1812-2146-4893.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {R}.
Repeat.

864-933-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
